name: Voluntary AI Safety Standard & Proposals Paper for Mandatory Guardrails for AI in High-Risk Settings (2024)
description: Voluntary AI Safety Standard and Proposals Paper for Introducing Mandatory Guardrails for AI in High-Risk Settings (September 5, 2024). Whole-of-government artificial intelligence strategy and governance framework coordinated by the Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR) and the Australian Government.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au).
